The '''GSI-24D disruptor pistol''' was a [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] used by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] around [[980 BBY]]. Such disruptors were banned on some [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as [[Doan]].
